headline: 14 years later: Arsenal go top of Premier League after beating Liverpool
summary: Kai Havertz's early goal secured a 1-0 victory at Anfield, marking Arsenal's first league win at the stadium in over a decade.
details: Arsenal have moved three points clear at the top of the Premier League following a statement 1-0 victory over Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday.
caption:

headline_marked: Cox's Bazar: [[Gas leak causes fire during tubewell drilling]]
headline: Cox's Bazar: Gas leak causes fire during tubewell drilling
summary: Authorities expect the fire to subside naturally within 15 days, but alternative measures will be taken if it persists.
details: A fire broke out during the drilling of a deep tubewell in the Jaliapalong Union of Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar, after gas leaked from the underground.
caption:
A tubewell drilling project in Cox's Bazar turned into a fire after gas leaked from 1,000 feet underground.

A fire broke out during the drilling of a deep tubewell in the Jaliapalong Union of Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar, after gas leaked from the underground.
